notes:
YLLW 0.5.7
- New built-in demo site: a playful YLLW product site (home, pricing and contact) replaces FieldKit. It sizes fluidly and switches to phone, tablet, desktop and wide desktop layouts, with a tag showing which layout each pane is on.
- Code editor: open a site's folder, preview it in every pane, and edit its HTML and CSS side by side. CSS shows in every pane as you type; Ctrl+S saves the real files, keeps a backup of the first save, and won't overwrite a file that changed on disk without asking.
- One button on the floating bar switches every pane to dark, light or the system setting. The sun or moon on a pane's header still sets one pane apart, and the bar shows Mixed when panes differ.
- Fit in Free layout zooms so your panes fill the width of the screen, with Add a device close to the scroll bar. Tall arrangements scroll down, and closing a pane refits.
- A width dragged on an element can no longer push the page wider than a phone screen.
- The tour covers the Code editor, the all-panes light/dark button and the new Fit.
